name: Vinod Saraf
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2021-2025); Hurun Global (2020-2026); Hurun India (2016-2022)
forbes_bio: An MBA from BITS Pilani, Vinod Saraf started his career working for Aditya Birla, billionaire Kumar Birla's late father.
In 1989, he set up his own venture to manufacture isobutyl benzene, the key raw material used for making ibuprofen, a popular painkiller.
His listed Vinati Organics is now among the world's largest producers (by volume) of ibuprofen.
His older daughter Vinati Mutreja, a Wharton grad after whom the company is named, now runs the company as CEO and managing director.

name: Eduard Chukhlebov
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2018-2021); Hurun Global (2020-2026)
forbes_bio: Eduard Chukhlebov has ties to the powerful founder of Ural Mining Metallurgical Company (UMMC) Iskander Makhmudov.
When Makhmudov reorganized his business, he gave Chukhlebov, one of his managers, a 7.5% stake in UMMC.
Chukhlebov also owns minority stakes in thermal coal producer Kuzbassrazrezugol and transportation company Ugol-Trans through UMMC.
UMMC, which is the biggest zinc, copper and coal producer in Russia, operates more than 300 companies in nine regions of Russia.

name: Ryan Israel
sec_insider_companies: PERSHING SQUARE INC. (PS) - Chief Investment Officer; Pershing Square USA, Ltd. (PSUS) - Chief Investment Officer; Howard Hughes Holdings Inc. (HHH) - Chief Investment Officer
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2025); Hurun Global (2026); Hurun Global U40 (2026); SEC insider holdings (2026)
forbes_bio: Ryan Israel is the chief investment officer of Pershing Square Capital Management, the hedge fund founded by Bill Ackman in 2004.
Pershing Square has $16 billion in assets under management and was valued at $10.5 billion when outside investors bought 10% of the firm in June 2024.
A University of Pennsylvania graduate, Israel joined Pershing Square early in his career in 2009 following two years in investment banking at Goldman Sachs.
Ackman named Israel his CIO and eventual successor in 2022.
forbes_facts: Israel was named to Forbes' 30 Under 30 list in the finance category in 2015.

name: Cui Lijie
appears_on: Forbes real-time (former) (2020); Forbes annual (2015-2018); Hurun Global (2015-2018)
forbes_bio: Cui Lijie owns the majority of Imperial Pacific International Holdings.
The company has been granted an exclusive casino license for Saipan in the Commonwealth of Northern Marianas Islands, a U.S. Pacific territory.
Imperial Pacific ran a temporary casino in a local shopping mall until the gaming section of its $600 million beachfront hotel opened in July 2017.
Cui's son Ji Xiaobo, formerly an executive with Macau junket promoter Hengsheng Group, has been dubbed 'mastermind' of the Saipan project.
Cui has been majority owner of Imperial Pacific since its 2013 listing but only joined the company's board of directors in May 2017.
forbes_facts: In addition to its hotel, Imperial Pacific has proposed developing a multibillion casino district similar to Macau's Cotai Strip.
Cui worked as a so-called barefoot doctor in mainland China.
Prior to Imperial Pacific, Cui was a real estate investor and jewelry collector.

name: Lowell Milken
appears_on: Forbes real-time (former) (2021); Forbes annual (2008-2020)
forbes_bio: Lowell Milken is the younger brother and the former right-hand man of former financier Michael Milken.
Mike Milken expanded the market for high-yield junk bonds while at investment bank Drexel Burnham Lambert in the 1980s.
Lowell is the chairman and partial owner of Heron International, a London-based real estate firm that develops, invests in and manages properties.
He cofounded education firm Knowledge Universe in the mid 1990s.
In 2015, Knowledge Universe sold its early childhood education business to private equity firm Partners Group for an undisclosed sum.

name: Guo Jiangang
appears_on: Forbes real-time (former) (2023); Forbes annual (2021-2022); Hurun Global (2020-2026); Hurun China (2007-2026)
forbes_bio: Guo Jiangang chairs Guangdong Xinbao Electrical Appliances Holdings, a producer of kitchen appliances.
Xinbao holds rights for the Morphy Richards appliance brand in China and has found success through social media.
Xinbao also sells its own Donlim brand.

name: Jonathan Oringer
appears_on: Forbes real-time (former) (2024); Forbes annual (2014-2024); SEC insider holdings (2026)
forbes_bio: Jon Oringer started Shutterstock with $10,000 in 2003 to create a more affordable way to supply stock photos.
He took the photo service public in 2012 and served as its CEO until April 2020, when he became executive chairman.
Oringer owns nearly 33% of Shutterstock, which had 2021 revenues of $773 million.
A serial entrepreneur, Oringer created one of the first pop-up blockers as a computer science graduate student at Columbia University.
In October 2020, he reportedly spent $42 million to buy a mansion in Miami Beach and moved there from New York City.
forbes_facts: To launch Shutterstock, he bought a camera, took 30,000 pictures and started a website that sold pictures for cheap.

name: Benedicte Find
appears_on: Forbes real-time (former) (2025); Forbes annual (2020-2025); Hurun Global (2021-2025)
forbes_bio: Benedicte Find is the daughter of the late Aage Louis-Hansen, founder of Danish healthcare company Coloplast.
Coloplast provides medical devices and services in the fields of colostomy, continence and urology; products include colostomy bags and catheters.
The company went public in 1983 and trades on the Copenhagen Stock Exchange. Find owns approximately 4% of Coloplast stock.
Her brother, Niels Peter Louis-Hansen, is Coloplast's deputy chairman. He is also a billionaire.
Find, an architect, is based in Copenhagen.

name: Mark Creasy
appears_on: Forbes real-time (former) (2023); Sunday Times Rich List (2020)
forbes_bio: Mark Creasy is one of Australia's most successful prospectors. He has a minority stake in nickel and lithium miner IGO and a clutch of other mining stocks.
He got his big break in 1979 while searching for pieces of the downed Skylab space station in the Fraser Range.
Creasy found a large nickel deposit which led to the Nova nickel mine.

name: Kim Chang-soo
appears_on: Forbes real-time (former) (2021-2026); Forbes annual (2021-2023); Hurun Global (2022-2024); SEC insider holdings (2026)
forbes_bio: Kim Chang-soo is chairman of F&F, which he started as an apparel business in 1992.
The company carries the Korea license for Western brands such as Warner Bros' outdoor label Discovery Expedition as well as streetwear brand Major League Baseball (MLB).
In 2021, F&F Holdings spun off its core clothing business to form a new company called F&F Co.
forbes_facts: Kim was formerly CEO of Artbox, a subsidiary of Samsung Publishing.
Kim's nephew, Kim Min-seok, is cofounder and CEO of Pinkfong, the company behind the viral song "Baby Shark Dance."
